title: Page 8
lines: “普通的地方能造就那些人才？”
“不能吗？”
众人使劲地摇首，“绝对不能……”
再莱迷惑地看向顾醒，而他只是将她轻揽至怀中。
“乖，你师门是个特例，天上地下独一家的。”别人想学还都学不来。
她有点懂又不太懂，“喔……”
对人间还不算太熟的白十一，终于代众人问出了重心中的重心。
“我说，你师门的人到底是谁教出来的啊？”不但品种特异，还一个比一个有特色。
“大师兄教的啊。”
“大师兄……”众人眼睛一亮，“对了，你们的大师兄是谁？”全江湖都知道蓬莱在黄金门排行第二，可却没有人知道在他上头的又是哪一位。
“他叫——”再莱才张口欲说，然后又像是及时醒悟过来，急急以两手捂住嘴。
“小莱？”
她摇摇头，两手没敢放下，“不可以说。”
“为何不能说？”
“会被灭口的。”大师兄虽一心向佛，但该凶残的时候，照凶残不误。
“……”这个师门真的正常吗？
路翔万分同情地看向老神在在的顾醒，决定在他往火炕里跳前还是先劝谏个一回。
“仙师，你真看上她了？要不要再重新考虑一下？”风险也高得太离谱了吧？
顾醒一脸不在意，“不必。”
“可那黄金门……”
“没事，我对他们熟得很。”还在天上时，他老早就见识过那一家子最想让人知道、和最不想让人知道的一面，他一点也没将那些个怪胎给放在心上。
待到夜色更深了些许，前来打听消息的也都被顾醒赶回去后，还没什么睡意的再莱站在花厅的厅门口边，一径地打量着外头。
“在瞧什么？”
“那个女人呢？”奇怪，戴月公主不是一天到晚都缠着仙师的吗？怎么今日都没见她又来耀武扬咸？
“今儿一早她就急急忙忙赶回南贞了。”顾醒转回她朝外探看的小脑袋，顺手把厅门关上，将森冷的寒意隔绝在外。
再莱瞪大了眼，“不跟我抢了？”她有这么简单就放弃吗？
“你不都写信给你二师兄搬救兵了？蓬莱他还能让人欺负你？”他以指弹她光洁的额头，好笑地看着她一脸的呆样。
再莱捂着额怔楞了好一会儿，然后漾出了个如释重负的笑脸。
“我就知道二师兄对我最好了！”不但很厉害还有求必应。
“对你最好？”顾醒面色冷了冷，微微扬高了声调，“嗯？”
“呃……”她说的是实话呀，有什么不对吗？
低首看着浑然不知自己说错什么话的她，顾醒一步步地逼近她。
“其实……你只差二师兄一点点。”她边退边试图补救。
“哼。”其只仙龟自鼻孔噌出两团冷气。
她赶紧改口，“不过你比他温柔很多很多！”
“是吗？”顾醒一手环着她的，际将她给圈住，然后大步带着她走回寝室，准备与她彻夜讨论一番，关于她心中排名的老问题。
“没有这么小气的啦……”再莱挂在他的手上欲哭无泪地道，没想到就马上被拍了两下屁股作为惩罚。
他搂紧她，“我小气？回房后看我怎么收拾你。”
再莱楞张着嘴，有些不敢置信。
“她成亲了？”这怎么可能？不是说非他不嫁吗？
顾醒心情很好地扶上她的下巴，缓缓告诉她这几日南贞国所发生的事。
“戴月公主一回国就被南贞女皇给押着去成亲了，至于原因嘛，听说与你家四师姊有关。”
听总爱窥探人间八卦的白十一说，南贞女皇为了付款赎画，本就已对黄金门恨意在心头了，没想到戴月公主竟不能体会她的苦衷，还一心想回路国找她的仙师，这让南贞女皇气得终于舍下了姊妹之情，直接把这名招惹来黄金门的妹子给嫁了，好让她不再给南贞招惹祸端。
“四师姊做了什么？”明明师姊就是个斯文人啊，这怎会与她有关？
“你是好孩子，所以不知道也罢。”顾醒太了解月穹那个女人了，打死他也不许再莱有机会被那女人给带坏。
“喔……”她迷迷糊糊的，眼下只在意一点，“那我们什么时候私奔？”
“我想，应该不必了。”顾醒爱怜地抚着每当她绽放笑颜时，就会出现在她脸上的小小梨涡。
她好不失望，“为什么？”
“因为你师门的人已经到了。”他说完后转首看向路翔所在的锻日宫。
刚退朝就被这票不知打哪儿冒出来的黄金门门人给吓到的路翔，呐呐地看着这些再莱口中可亲又可爱的师兄姊弟。
这真是……太有面子了。
江湖上难得一见的黄金门门人，一下子就来了这么多，还一个个都是路国得罪不起的相级大人物。
“仙师……”总算盼到？？来迟解救他的顾醒，路翔像是见着了救星般忙跑向他。
顾醒将他推至一边，“不关你的事，等会儿闪远点就是了。”
被顾醒牵着手带来朝殿上的再莱，怎么也没想到，平常除了上坟时间外，难得见上一面的师门众人，居然都跟她一样跑到路国来了。
月穹对她漾着和蔼可亲的笑脸，“小六，过来过来……”
不假思索地，再莱小跑步地扑进月穹的怀里。
月穹摸摸她的小脑袋，“这一年你有没有乖？”
“很好，这是师姊给你的奖励。”她笑咪咪地自怀中掏出一本新出版的小黄书。
再莱正要伸手接过，站在不玩处的顾醒冷眸一凛，一？指就让那本为恶的小黄书在空中灰飞烟灭。
月穹阴沉的眼神登时向他扫了过去，他却有恃无恐地扬高了下颔。
“小六啊。”容易才不管他们在暗涛汹涌些什么，“来来来，五师兄带了礼物给你，你看看喜不喜欢？”
“五师兄你真好！”再莱光看到他身后那一大袋都是准备要给她的礼物，就乐得刚才发生了什么都忘了。
容易得意地道：“那可不？”
听得满心不是滋味的顾醒衣袖一扬，骤然伸长的衣袖就卷住再莱的腰际，一把将她给卷回他的身边。
“喂！你这是什么意思？”脾气不太好的容易，在被搅了好事之后很冲地对他道。
顾醒连说都懒得说上一字，他？弹指，不但将这两个行为举止都让他看得很是不痛快的家伙给架上空中，顺道也把还没有半点动静的莫追，也一迸给送了上去，陪着他们一道来个滚滚滚。
下一刻，一柄冰凉的黑剑已悬在顾醒的颈间。
“放他们下来。”玄灵无声无息地出现在他身后。
光看到玄灵亮出吃饭的家伙，再莱就被吓得眼中泛起了泪光。
“三师兄……”
玄灵定眼瞧了瞧她悬在眼瞎上的泪珠，颇不情愿地收剑回鞘。
他朝她伸出手，“小六，回家了。”
“仙师一起走？”再莱忙抱着她万般想装进行李中的顾醒。
面上向来都没太多表情的玄灵，几不可见地蹙着一双好看的剑眉，而刚被放下地，犹在天旋地转的三人，则是摇摇晃晃地走至玄灵的身后。
再莱渴盼地看着他，“不可以吗？”
“他又不是咱们家的。”玄灵不悦地道。
“他是我的！”
“小六？”所有人都被她这难得一见剧烈的反应给吓了一跳。
再莱不死心地抱紧顾醒大声宣告，“他是我的，所以他要跟我一起走！”
某四人异口同声，“不行！”
顾醒弯身看向抱着他放声大哭的再莱，好不心疼地拍抚着她的背脊。

"Can ordinary places cultivate those talents?"
"Can't you?"
Everyone shook their heads vigorously, "Absolutely not..."
Zai Lai looked at Gu Xing in confusion, but he just held her gently in his arms.
"Good boy, your school is a special case, the only one in the world." Others can't learn it even if they want to.
She kind of understood but not quite understood, "Oh..."
Bai Shiyi, who was not too familiar with the human world, finally asked the center of gravity on behalf of everyone.
"Let me ask, who taught the people in your sect?" Not only are the varieties unique, but each one is more distinctive than the other.
"Elder brother taught me."
"Eldest Brother..." Everyone's eyes lit up, "By the way, who is your Eldest Brother?" Everyone in the world knew that Penglai ranked second in the Golden Gate, but no one knew who was above him.
"His name is -" Zai Lai opened his mouth to speak, but then seemed to wake up in time and hurriedly covered his mouth with both hands.
"Xiao Lai?"
She shook her head, not daring to put down her hands, "You can't say that."
"Why can't you tell me?"
"You will be silenced." Although the eldest brother is devoted to the Buddha, he still behaves cruelly when he should be cruel.
"..." Is this sect really normal?
Lu Xiang looked at Gu Xing with great sympathy, and decided to give him some advice before jumping into the fire bed.
"Master Immortal, are you really attracted to her? Do you want to reconsider?" The risk is too high, right?
Gu Xing looked unconcerned and said, "No need."
"But the Golden Gate..."
"It's okay, I'm very familiar with them." When he was still in heaven, he had already seen the side of that family that he wanted people to know the most and the side that he didn't want people to know the most. He didn't take those freaks to heart at all.
When the night got darker and everyone who came to inquire about the news was driven back by Gu Xing, Zai Lai, who was still not sleepy, stood by the entrance of the flower hall and looked outside.
"What are you looking at?"
"Where is that woman?" Strange, isn't Princess Daiyue pestering the Immortal Master all day long? Why haven't I seen her show off her strength today?
"She hurried back to Nanzhen early this morning." Gu Xing turned her little head back towards the outside and closed the hall door to block out the cold chill.
Zai Lai's eyes widened, "Don't you want to fight with me?" Did she give up so easily?
"Didn't you write to your second senior brother to bring in reinforcements? How can Penglai let people bully you?" He flicked her smooth forehead with his finger and looked at her dumbfounded expression in amusement.
Zai Lai covered his forehead and was stunned for a while, and then showed a relieved smile.
"I knew that Second Senior Brother was the best to me!" Not only was he very powerful, but he also responded to every request.
"What's best for you?" Gu Xing's face turned cold and he raised his voice slightly, "Huh?"
"Uh..." She was telling the truth. Is there anything wrong?
Looking down at her, who had no idea what he said wrong, Gu Xing approached her step by step.
"Actually... you are only a little short of the second senior brother." She retreated while trying to make up for it.
"Hmph." Two puffs of cold air came out of its nostrils.
She quickly changed her words, "But you are much, much gentler than him!"
"Really?" Gu Xing put an arm around hers, trapping her, and then strode with her back to the dormitory, preparing to discuss with her all night about the old questions that ranked in her heart.
"You're not that stingy..." Zai Lai said without tears, hanging on his hand. Unexpectedly, he was immediately slapped on the butt twice as punishment.
He hugged her tightly, "Am I stingy? Let's see how I deal with you when we get back to the room."
Zai Laileng opened his mouth in disbelief.
"She's married?" How is this possible? Didn’t you say that you won’t marry anyone but him?
Gu Xing held her chin in a good mood and slowly told her what had happened in Nan Zhen Kingdom in the past few days.
"As soon as Princess Daiyue returned to the country, she was escorted by Queen Nanzhen to get married. As for the reason, I heard that it was related to your fourth senior sister."
Bai Shiyi, who always likes to pry into human gossip, said that Queen Nanzhen already hated the Golden Gate in order to pay for the painting. Unexpectedly, Princess Daiyue could not understand her difficulties and wanted to return to Lu Kingdom to find her immortal master. This made Queen Nanzhen so angry that she finally gave up on the relationship between sisters and directly married the girl who had provoked the Golden Gate so that she would no longer cause trouble for Nanzhen.
"What did Fourth Senior Sister do?" Senior Sister is obviously a gentle person, so how could this have anything to do with her?
"You're a good boy, so it's okay if you don't know." Gu Xing knew that woman Yue Qiong too well, and he wouldn't let him be led astray by that woman again.
"Oh..." She was in a daze, and she only cared about one thing at the moment, "Then when will we elope?"
"I think it won't be necessary." Gu Xing lovingly stroked the little pear dimples that would appear on her face whenever she smiled.
She was so disappointed, "Why?"
"Because the people from your master's sect have arrived." After he finished speaking, he turned to look at the Forging Sun Palace where Lu Xiang was.
Lu Xiang, who had just retired from the imperial court, was frightened by the members of the Golden Sect who appeared out of nowhere. He stared at these senior brothers and sisters who Zai Lai said were amiable and lovely.
This is really... so honorable.
There were so many golden sect members who were rare in the world, and all of them were high-ranking figures in the Lu Kingdom who could not afford to offend them.
"Immortal Master..." Finally what he was looking forward to? ? Gu Xing came late to rescue him, and Lu Xiang hurriedly ran to him as if he had seen his savior.
Gu Xing pushed him aside, "It's none of your business, just stay away later."
"Yes."
Zai Lai, who was led to the court by Gu Xing's hand, never expected that all the members of the master's sect, who were rarely seen except during grave visits, would actually come to Lu Kingdom like her.
Yue Qiong smiled kindly at her, "Xiao Liu, come here..."
Without thinking, Zai Lai ran into Yue Qiong's arms.
Yue Qiong touched her little head and asked, "Have you been good this year?"
"Yes!"
"Very good, this is a reward from Senior Sister." She smiled and took out a newly published pornographic book from her arms.
Just as Zai Lai was about to reach out and take it, Gu Xing, who was standing where he was not playing, gave a cold look, "?" Just let the evil little pornographic book disappear into ashes in the air.
Yue Qiong's gloomy eyes immediately glanced at him, but he raised his chin confidently.
"Xiao Liu." Yi Yi didn't care what they were talking about, "Come on, come on, the fifth senior brother has brought you a gift, see if you like it?"
"Fifth Senior Brother, you are so kind!" Zai Laiguang saw that the big bag behind him was full of gifts for her, and he was so happy that he forgot what happened just now.
It's easy to say proudly: "Isn't that right?"
Gu Xing, who was filled with discomfort after hearing this, raised his sleeves, and the suddenly stretched sleeves wrapped around Zai Lai's waist, pulling her back to his side.
"Hey! What do you mean?" Yi Yi, who has a bad temper, said to him angrily after being disturbed.
Gu Xing didn't even bother to say a word, him? With a snap of his fingers, he not only lifted these two guys whose behavior made him very unhappy into the air, but also sent Mo Zhui up, who had not made any movement at all, to accompany them.
The next moment, a cold black sword was hanging on Gu Xing's neck.
"Let them down." Xuan Ling appeared behind him silently.
Zai Lai was so frightened that tears welled up in his eyes just when he saw Xuan Ling showing off the guy who was eating.
"Third Senior Brother..."
Xuan Ling looked at the tears hanging on her eyes and reluctantly sheathed the sword.
He stretched out his hand towards her, "Xiao Liu, go home."
"Master Immortal, are you leaving together?" Zai Lai hurriedly hugged Gu Xing, who she tried to put in her luggage.
Xuan Ling, who never had much expression on his face, frowned with a pair of beautiful sword-shaped eyebrows. The three people who had just been put down and were still spinning staggered behind Xuan Ling.
Zai Lai looked at him longingly, "Can't you?"
"He's not from our family." Xuan Ling said displeased.
"He's mine!"
"Xiao Liu?" Everyone was startled by her rare and violent reaction.
Zai Lai hugged Gu Xing tightly and declared loudly, "He is mine, so he wants to come with me!"
A certain four people said in unison, "No!"
"Wow——"
Gu Xing bent over and looked at Zai Lai, who was holding him and crying loudly, and patted her back with great pain.
